selection_rule: Same two seeds, parent fit/dev lists, frozen DCN anchor, same candidate data, list loss and epochs. Per arm lock epoch and residual scale using development mean NDCG@10, then HR@10, then earlier epoch and lower scale. Prefer configurations preserving dev HR@10 and cold+tail hit count. Recommend a challenger only if it also improves dev NDCG. Confirm both locked arms once on 10000 users outside parent fit/dev/fresh and known older evaluation cohorts.
